question.prompt: A product costs 80 yuan and has a marked price of 120 yuan. The store sells it at \(x\) tenths of the marked price. To achieve a profit rate of at least \(20\%\), what is the minimum number of tenths? (Enter the minimum value of \(x\).)

solutions.explanation: The selling price is \(120\times x/10\). A profit rate of at least \(20\%\) means the selling price must be \(\geq80\times1.2=96\), so \(12x\geq96\), giving \(x\geq8\). Thus, the minimum selling price is 8 tenths of the marked price.
solutions.title: Profit threshold
